audit.why: Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon in both layers, against 51.46% over 2641 games — a genuinely close lane. The prose agrees that Pantheon banks the early levels and Sylas takes the scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike says 'only press R when his R is on cooldown' without ever saying how long that is.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s. At rank 1 that is 80 seconds — a real, waitable window, and the difference between 'hold your ult forever' and 'hold it for 80 seconds'. Abscond/Abduct is 13s at rank 1 (400 range) and Kingslayer 12s.
audit.corrected: Hijack's 80s written into spikes[2] and mid; Abscond's 13s/400 and Kingslayer's 12s into breakdown.cooldowns and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup attributes Sylas's healing to his Q in five places — 'his Q drain ring needs to hit AND tick to heal', 'a free Q drain ring to heal on', 'his Q/W drain and heal', 'Q-W drain-heal', 'Q/W drain-heal'. Chain Lash does not heal.
audit.why: Riot: Chain Lash (Q) 'lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point.' Damage and a slow, with a delayed detonation — no healing at all. The heal is Kingslayer (W): 'Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.' A player told to deny the Q ring is watching the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Kingslayer named as the heal throughout; Chain Lash described as a slow with a delayed explosion.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Land E chain-dash stun', 'so the stun whiffs', and the full layer's 'His dash + stun (recast pull)' — Abscond/Abduct has no stun.
audit.why: Riot: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' It is a dash plus a self-pull. Believing there is a stun on it changes whether you think you can walk away from a trade after he lands, which you can.
audit.corrected: Described as a dash with a recast pull, explicitly not a stun, in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Petricite Burst is never mentioned, and Grievous Wounds is never mentioned despite the whole late-game section being about healing.
audit.why: Petricite Burst charges after every spell cast and turns his next basic attack into an AoE chain whirl with bonus attack speed, which is where a lot of his short-trade damage comes from. And the _missing-interactions file flags needs-antiheal for this pairing: Kingslayer is the reason your combo does not stick past two items.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into whys[6] and late as the actual answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright'.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will; no passive shield exists.

edits.before: Sylas is an even AP fight that scales, so the early levels are where you bank your lead. At 1 your point-and-click W stun plus a tapped Q out-damages anything he can do before his E. At 2-3 force the W-stun-into-Q all-in — he has no real escape until his E chain-dash, and his Q drain ring needs to hit AND tick to heal, so blow him up before it pays off. Angle your E channel to face his Q ring and his E1 dash so his stun setup whiffs.
edits.after: Sylas is an even AP fight that scales, so the early levels are where you bank your lead. At 1 your point-and-click Shield Vault plus a tapped Comet Spear out-damages anything he has before Abscond. At 2-3 force the W-stun-into-Q all-in — his only escape is that dash, and his heal is Kingslayer (W, 12s at rank 1), not the Chain Lash ring, so blow him up before the lunge pays for itself. Face Aegis Assault at the delayed explosion.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke and E blocks, but Sylas stabilizes with his drain-heal and the trades even out. At 6 respect the steal: his R copies YOUR Grand Starfall, so never throw your R into him when his ult is up — hold it, or only commit when his R is down. Keep poking with held long-range Q from outside his E-dash range and don't give him a free Q drain ring to heal on.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke, but Kingslayer's heal stabilizes him and the trades even out. At 6 respect the steal: Hijack copies YOUR Grand Starfall and it is 80s at rank 1, so never throw R while his is up — hold it, or commit on his cooldown. Keep poking from outside Abscond's 400-unit dash range and deny him the free Kingslayer lunges he heals on.

edits.before: This is where Sylas takes over. His Q/W drain and heal plus AP items like Riftmaker and Cosmic Drive sustain straight through your burst while your damage plateaus — a fed Sylas just heals your combo and chain-dashes onto you. Your only answer is to have already won: convert your early tempo into Starfall roams and objectives so the game ends before his second item, because in a straight late-game duel he out-sustains and out-scales you.
edits.after: This is where Sylas takes over. Kingslayer's heal plus AP items like Riftmaker and Cosmic Drive sustain straight through your burst while your damage plateaus — a fed Sylas heals your combo off and chain-dashes back onto you. Grievous Wounds is not optional here. Your only answer is to have already won: convert your early tempo into Starfall roams and objectives so the game ends before his second item.

edits.after: Mortal Will empowers your next cast and Comet Spear out-pokes him at level 1, before Abscond gives him any escape.

notes: Two mechanical errors, both repeated. First, five strings credit Sylas's healing to his Q — 'his Q drain ring needs to hit AND tick to heal', 'don't give him a free Q drain ring to heal on', 'Q/W drain and heal'. Chain Lash deals damage, slows, and detonates after a delay; it has no healing whatsoever. The heal is Kingslayer (W, 12s at rank 1), a lunge that heals against champions. A Pantheon player watching the Q ring to decide whether Sylas has sustained is watching the wrong ability. Second, both layers describe Abscond/Abduct as a 'dash + stun' or 'chain-dash stun'. Riot's text is a dash with a recast that pulls Sylas to an enemy — no stun. That matters because it changes whether the player believes they can walk out of a trade after he lands on them. Added the one number the level-6 advice was missing: Hijack is 80 seconds at rank 1, so 'hold your ultimate' has a defined end. Grievous Wounds is now named in the late-game text, which previously described the healing problem across three sentences without ever naming the counter.
